# JS Central — Public Archive
> A static, manually maintained archive of publicly available content from https://jscentral.org/.

## About
This repository preserves the public pages and browser-side experiments of JS Central. It is not the live site, is not synchronized automatically, and may be incomplete or out of date.

## Pages
- Archived homepage: ./index.html
- Browser experiments: ./lab.html
- Embedded-systems guide: ./embedded-guide.html
- Engineering journal: ./journal.html
- Seasonal page: ./seasonal.html
- Archive legal notice: ./legal.html

## Privacy and external services
The archive does not include advertising scripts or analytics. Theme preference and embedded-guide notes remain in the visitor's browser. Google Fonts and the optional YouTube player are external services and may receive technical request information when used. Hosting providers may process request information to operate the archive.

## Source and corrections
- Live site: https://jscentral.org/
- Repository: https://github.com/PixelPilotPrograms/Public-Archive-Jscentral
- Correction/removal requests can be opened as public repository issues. Do not post confidential or sensitive information there.

## Content
Technical material is provided for general reference and education without warranty. See ./legal.html for terms, accessibility, privacy, and copyright details.
